g.text: 12 new empty-history games | n = 6 games per arm | policies disclosed from round 1
Thin lines show individual games; bold lines show arm means over the same six complete games.
Shading marks rounds 1–3, when punishment is forced OFF; policy assignment and disclosure occur from the start.
These are descriptive complete-policy paths. They do not separately identify effects mediated by language, enforcement or contributions.
The old two-game pilot is excluded; no rounds, messages or actions are imputed.
